message_text: The financial aid section of the portal shows completely different numbers than what my award letter says
I'm sorry for the confusion. The portal sometimes takes 1-2 business days to sync after award letters are sent. Are the numbers higher or lower?
Lower. My award letter says $8,000 in grants but the portal shows $5,500.
That discrepancy should be resolved once the portal updates. If it persists after 48 hours, please contact the Financial Aid office to reconcile the amounts.
So I should just trust the letter and ignore the portal? That doesn't inspire confidence.
I understand your concern. The award letter is the official document. I recommend screenshotting both for your records and following up with Financial Aid if the discrepancy continues.
